Definition: Azriel, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Azriel = "my help is God"; 1) a head of a house of the half-tribe of Manasseh beyond the Jordan; 2) a Naphtalite, ancestor of Jerimoth, the head of the tribe at the time of the census of David; 3) father of Seraiah, an officer of king Jehoiakim of Judah
